body: We introduce Hyperbolic Symplectic Positional Encoding (HySPE), grounding positional attention in non-compact symplectic transformations. While canonical Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) parameterizes the compact, elliptic branch of (2,) via rotations, HySPE operationalizes its hyperbolic branch via a damped symmetric composition of dual shears, yielding a conformally symplectic contraction with two spectral decay rates per channel pair. To eliminate the exponential representation drift inherent to naive absolute factorizations, we diagonalize the operator in its invariant eigenbasis and introduce blockwise coordinate rebasing with adaptive centered execution. This guarantees length-independent numerical bounds while matching cached RoPE forward latency (7.21 ms on an RTX 4090). On TinyShakespeare, HySPE-UltraLong maintains an invariant perplexity of 4.810 up to 16× zero-shot extrapolation (L=4096), whereas RoPE degrades to 131.198. Scaled to a 51M-parameter subword Transformer on WikiText-103 (Ltrain=512), HySPE closely matches RoPE in-domain while robustly extrapolating to length 8192, reducing tail perplexity by 83.9% over RoPE. While these controlled experiments establish HySPE's extrapolation robustness and numerical stability, evaluating its scaling behavior on large-scale foundation models remains an important direction for future investigation.
summaryZh: 本文介绍了双曲辛位置编码（HySPE），通过双剪切的阻尼对称组合实现位置注意力。相比于RoPE的旋转参数化，HySPE利用双曲分支实现了具有两个谱衰减率的共形辛收缩，有效解决了长文本外推中的数值漂移问题。实验显示，在TinyShakespeare任务中，HySPE在16倍零样本外推下保持了稳定的困惑度，为Transformer架构的长序列处理提供了新的技术路径。
